name: Gottlieb Hipp

residences.place: Easton / Forks Twp., Northampton Co., PA

events.title: Marriage to Maria Catharina Grub
events.description: Per her St. John's Lutheran (Easton) burial entry: married Gottlieb Hipp 21 Jan 1777, 'lived together 59 years'.

events.title: Will
events.description: Names wife Catharine and 'John Grub, Frederic Grub, & Elizabeth Michael' as 'the brothers and sister of my said wife'; also a John Ihrie (probably a nephew). Will Book 6 pp.18-19.

bioAdditions: Gottlieb Hipp married Maria Catharina Grub (b. 25 Nov 1755), daughter of Andreas and Maria Elisabeth Grub, on 21 Jan 1777. Her death entry at St. John's Lutheran, Easton, says they 'lived together 59 years'; she died 19 Mar 1836 (S1). He appears in the 1790 census around Easton/Forks Township. His will, dated 9 Jun 1826 and proved 28 Oct 1839, refers to 'John Grub, Frederic Grub, & Elizabeth Michael' as his wife's brothers and sister (S1). That makes it a document naming Frederick Grub (John Meier's 5th-great-grandfather) as living, and as Catharine's brother, in 1826.

relationships.evidence: Andreas Grub's 1791 will ('Catherine the wife of Gotlieb Hipp'); Catharina's death entry
